trends.title: Both competitors are heading for the 5 to 20 tech shop
trends.detail: ServiceTitan is hiring sales reps for it and fixing its onboarding for it. Jobber is adding features that shops of that size ask for. This is our core segment.

trends.title: Jobber is targeting Housecall Pro customers directly
trends.detail: A switching guide, a new comparison page, and a cheaper entry plan in three weeks. Expect more switch conversations at renewal.

trends.title: 'We'll grow into it' is ServiceTitan's best argument
trends.detail: Owners who plan to grow pick the bigger platform. Reps need to test the growth plan early and price for it.

winLossQuestions.question: When ServiceTitan came up, did the owner say they'd grow into it? What size were they planning to reach, and by when?
winLossQuestions.gap: We don't know if we lose growing shops on features or on perception.

winLossQuestions.question: Did you compare total monthly cost with Jobber, including add-ons? Whose numbers did you use?
winLossQuestions.gap: Jobber's new comparison page (Signal #10) claims a lower total cost. We need the buyer's side.

winLossQuestions.question: Did anyone try Jobber's AI receptionist during the evaluation? Did it change the decision?
winLossQuestions.gap: No first-hand evidence yet on how Signal #5 plays in real deals.
